messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I'm lining up the sprint's release train for Thursday. Need owners for three lanes: api, model-serving, and infra-migrations. Target window: 10:00–12:00 PT. Who can own which and run smoke?
Sam: I'll take model-serving canary at 10:00 PT. I'll run smoke and monitor KV cache. :thumbsup: 
Priya: I can own API at 10:30. Will run the endpoint smoke and latency checks.
Lee: Infra-migrations sound like my lane. I'll coordinate with SRE for capacity. Can we make infra the last slot (11:30) so migrations don't block canaries?
Maya: Yeah let's do model-serving -> API -> infra. Sam, please set a canary at 2% traffic for the first 15m and then escalate.
Sam: Will do. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/512 — contains quantized variant toggles. I'll post smoke cmd below.
Sam: smoke command:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --suite canary --env prod --timeout 600
```
Priya: For API smoke I'll run the latency harness and synthetic prompt set (prompt-suite/v2). I'll post metrics to #eng-monitoring.
Lee: Migration runbook is uploaded: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/infra-mig-2026. Plan is DB schema-only changes, so rollback is DB snapshot + deploy rollback.
Maya: Add rollback owners: Sam -> model-serving rollback, Priya -> API rollback, Lee -> infra rollback + db restore.
Priya: API rollback steps: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=3` and restore config from S3 `s3://redwood-configs/api-prev.json`.
Sam: Model rollback: `helm rollback inference 2` also clear KV cache: `redis-cli FLUSHALL` (we'll coordinate with SRE before doing that).
Lee: DB snapshot: schedule at 11:00 PT, make sure PMs know the downtime window. I'll tag @ops-team.
DeployBot: Slot reserved by Maya for 2026-03-19 10:00 PT. Reminder will go out 1h before.
Maya: Thanks all. Final checklist: post PR links, add smoke owner in the deploy slot, quick handoff ping 30m prior. I'll compile a single checklist doc and paste here.
Sam: PR linked above. I'll also add a smoke log webhook to the deploy slot.
Priya: Added latency thresholds to the slot: p95 < 200ms, error rate < 0.5%.
Lee: Capacity check: requested +2 GPUs for 10:00–12:00 PT, SRE confirmed. @SRE please verify node draining won't overlap.
SRE: confirmed, nodes are green. We'll avoid draining during the 10:00–12:00 PT window.
Maya: Great. If nothing else, we'll lock the schedule by EOD and post the final deploy-owner table.
Priya: :raised_hands:
Sam: :rocket:
Lee: :white_check_mark:
